physiology:
The traditions seat this code in the urogenital diaphragm, the low sling of muscle at the floor of the pelvis, the small hammock the whole upright body rests on. It is the literal ground of you. Everything above it, the spine, the breath, the long climb of the trunk, is held up by this quiet sheet of tissue, and the body has placed the code of beginnings exactly there. Underneath the start.

The shadow has its bodily floor here. When the next thing is already pulling at you before the current thing has landed, this is where it shows. The pelvic floor tightens without being asked. The breath stops going all the way down. There is a small held charge low in the body that the mind reads as restlessness, as not yet, as somewhere else. Long stretches of starting and starting and starting leave that floor clenched. It is the body bracing against a beginning it has not yet learned to trust.

The climb out is bodily too. Breath returns to the base of you. The hammock softens. Sitting down becomes possible without the urge to be already moving. Walking slows on its own, the way a river widens near the sea. Expansion in this code is not a reach upward. It is the floor relaxing, and the rest of the body finally being allowed to rest on what was always carrying it.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the pelvic floor, this code answers to a single amino acid, Serine. Serine is one of the small set the body makes for itself. It does not have to be brought across from outside. The cells assemble it quietly, all the time, out of pieces already in hand.

There is a teaching in that, and it sits at the heart of this card. The Shadow keeps insisting the next beginning is somewhere ahead, one more arrival, one more thing to chase down and bring back. The chemistry says the opposite. The substance this code is built on is one the body is already making, in the dark, without being asked. Every beginning you keep running toward is being assembled in you already, lower down than the wanting. Serine sits in the very membrane of each cell, the small boundary where one beginning ends and the next begins. The code runs all the way down to this. A start you do not have to fetch. A start the body has been making all along, while you were busy looking for it elsewhere.
